overview.en: Pediatric skin disorders: eczema, impetigo, head lice, scabies and burns. Focus on infection control, correct topical medication use, home decontamination teaching and the special features of burns in children.
overview.zh: 小兒皮膚疾病：濕疹、膿痂疹、頭蝨、疥瘡與燒傷。重點為感染控制、外用藥正確使用、居家環境處理衛教，以及兒童燒傷的特殊性。

points.en: Superficial inflammation of the epidermis; linked to family history, allergies, asthma, allergic rhinitis.
points.zh: 表皮淺層發炎；與家族史、過敏、氣喘、過敏性鼻炎有關。

points.en: Signs: itching, redness, scaling, tiny papules and vesicles, weeping/oozing and crusting; typical on scalp, face, elbow/knee creases, neck, wrists, ankles; axilla, buttocks, groin uncommon.
points.zh: 症狀：搔癢、紅斑、脫屑、小丘疹與水泡、滲液結痂；好發頭皮、臉、肘膝彎處、頸、腕、踝；腋下、臀、鼠蹊少見。

points.en: Infantile form starts at 2-6 months and may remit by 3 years; childhood form 2-3 years; adolescent form from about 12 years onward.
points.zh: 嬰兒型 2–6 個月開始，3 歲前可能緩解；兒童型 2–3 歲；青少年型約 12 歲起。

points.en: Goals: relieve itch, hydrate skin, reduce inflammation, prevent/control secondary infection.
points.zh: 目標：止癢、保濕、消炎、預防或控制續發感染。

points.en: Short (5-10 min) lukewarm baths, oatmeal soothing; moisturize immediately with thick cream/ointment.
points.zh: 短時間（5–10 分鐘）微溫水浴，可用燕麥浴；浴後立即塗厚層乳霜或軟膏。

points.en: Topical medication goes on within 3 minutes after the bath, before the moisturizer; corticosteroids in a thin layer rubbed in well.
points.zh: 外用藥於浴後 3 分鐘內先塗，再塗保濕劑；類固醇薄塗並充分推開。

points.en: Avoid irritants: harsh soaps, detergents, fabric softeners, wipes, powder, wool, latex, heat, wet diapers.
points.zh: 避免刺激物：刺激性肥皂、洗衣精、柔軟精、濕紙巾、爽身粉、羊毛、乳膠、高溫、濕尿布。

points.en: Keep nails short, cover hands with gloves/cotton socks; cool wet compresses for itch.
points.zh: 指甲剪短，手戴手套或棉襪；冷濕敷止癢。

points.en: Honey-colored crusts with surrounding redness means secondary infection: seek care promptly.
points.zh: 蜜黃色痂皮伴周圍紅斑代表續發感染，應立即就醫。

points.en: Contagious skin infection by group A strep and Staphylococcus aureus; more common in hot, humid months, often at insect bites or damaged skin.
points.zh: 由 A 群鏈球菌與金黃色葡萄球菌引起的傳染性皮膚感染；炎熱潮濕季節多見，常發生於蚊蟲叮咬或受損皮膚。

points.en: Most common on face around mouth/nose, then hands, neck, extremities; vesicles/pustules rupture leaving honey-colored crusts.
points.zh: 好發於口鼻周圍，其次手、頸、四肢；水泡/膿疱破裂後留下蜜黃色痂皮。

points.en: Contact isolation plus standard precautions; contagious until 24 hours after antibiotics started.
points.zh: 接觸隔離加標準防護；開始抗生素後 24 小時內仍具傳染性。

points.en: Cover lesions, warm compresses 2-3 times daily to soften crusts, topical or oral antibiotics; finish the full course (risk of glomerulonephritis with strep).
points.zh: 覆蓋傷口，每日 2–3 次溫敷軟化痂皮，外用或口服抗生素；須完成療程（鏈球菌可併發腎絲球腎炎）。

points.en: Separate towels, linens, utensils; hot-water wash of linens; bleach the tub; short nails; careful handwashing.
points.zh: 毛巾、床單、餐具分開；寢具以熱水清洗；浴缸以漂白水清潔；指甲剪短；勤洗手。

points.en: Lice infest hair/scalp, mostly occipital area and behind ears; nits are glued to the hair shaft near the scalp and do not flake off like dandruff.
points.zh: 蝨子寄生頭髮與頭皮，多在枕部與耳後；蟲卵（蝨卵）牢固黏於近頭皮髮幹，不像頭皮屑易掉落。

points.en: Spread by direct/indirect contact (brushes, hats, towels, bedding); lice live about 48 hours off the host; nits hatch in 7-10 days.
points.zh: 經直接或間接接觸（梳子、帽子、毛巾、寢具）傳播；離開宿主約存活 48 小時；卵 7–10 天孵化。

points.en: Use pediculicide as prescribed; most not for infants under 6 months; lindane not for under 2 years (neurotoxicity, seizures).
points.zh: 依醫囑使用殺蝨劑；多數不適用 6 個月以下；林丹（lindane）不可用於 2 歲以下（神經毒性、癲癇）。

points.en: Daily nit removal with fine metal comb (wear gloves); examine and treat contacts as needed.
points.zh: 每日以細齒金屬梳除卵（戴手套）；檢查並視需要治療接觸者。

points.en: Launder clothing/bedding from previous 2 days in hot water and hot dryer 20 min; seal nonwashables in plastic bag 2 weeks; vacuum and discard bag; soak combs in boiling water 10 min.
points.zh: 洗滌前 2 天衣物寢具用熱水並熱烘 20 分鐘；不可洗物品密封塑膠袋 2 週；吸塵並丟棄集塵袋；梳子以沸水浸泡 10 分鐘。

points.en: Caused by the itch mite Sarcoptes scabiei; spread by close contact; infectious throughout the infestation.
points.zh: 由疥蟲引起；經密切接觸傳染；整個感染期皆具傳染性。

points.en: Findings: pruritic papular rash and burrows (fine grayish-red threadlike lines).
points.zh: 表現：搔癢丘疹與皮膚隧道（細灰紅色線狀）。

points.en: Permethrin: apply to cool, dry skin at least 30 min after bath, over all skin surfaces, head to soles per this chapter (scabicides in general: neck down, not face; follow product label), leave 8-14 hours, then wash off; repeat if needed.
points.zh: Permethrin：於沐浴後至少 30 分鐘、皮膚涼且乾時塗抹，全身皮膚（非僅皮疹處；本章述及頭至腳底，一般殺疥劑為頸部以下、避開臉，依產品說明）塗抹，停留 8–14 小時後洗去；必要時重複。

points.en: Treat all household members and contacts simultaneously.
points.zh: 所有同住者與接觸者須同時治療。

points.en: Change and hot-wash linens daily for at least 1 week; seal nonwashables in bags at least 4 days.
points.zh: 每日更換並熱水清洗寢具至少 1 週；不可洗物品密封至少 4 天。

points.en: Thinner skin: lower temperature and shorter exposure cause deeper burns; higher mortality in very young children.
points.zh: 皮膚較薄：較低溫度與較短時間即可造成深度燒傷；幼童死亡率較高。

points.en: A child's pain experience and ability to communicate it differ from an adult's with a comparable burn, so pain assessment must use age-appropriate tools rather than assuming adult-like pain behavior.
points.zh: 兒童對燒傷疼痛的感受與表達方式和成人不同（即使燒傷程度相近），疼痛評估須採用符合其年齡的工具，不能以成人的疼痛表現來類推。

points.en: Greater risk of fluid and heat loss, dehydration, metabolic acidosis, protein-calorie deficiency, infection, severe scarring, body image problems and growth delay.
points.zh: 較易發生水分與熱量散失、脫水、代謝性酸中毒、蛋白質熱量不足、感染、嚴重疤痕、身體心像問題與生長遲緩。

points.en: Do not use the rule of nines; use age-related charts (Lund-Browder type, Fig 30.3) for %TBSA.
points.zh: 勿用九分法；以依年齡之圖表（圖 30.3）估算燒傷面積百分比。

points.en: Burns >10% TBSA need fluid resuscitation during the first 24 hours; crystalloids first, colloids to maintain volume.
points.zh: 燒傷 >10% TBSA 需於前 24 小時液體復甦；先給晶體液，膠體液維持血容量。

points.en: Adequacy of resuscitation: heart rate, urine output, capillary refill, sensorium.
points.zh: 復甦是否足夠：心跳、尿量、微血管再充填、意識狀態。

points.en: First aid: stop burning, check airway, CAB if needed, remove burned clothing not stuck, cool (not cold) running water, cover clean, keep warm, call EMS.
points.zh: 急救：停止燒灼、確認呼吸道、必要時 CAB、移除未黏著衣物、以涼（非冰）流水沖、乾淨布覆蓋、保暖、呼叫 EMS。

critical_points.en: Monitor any child with a skin disorder for local skin infection and systemic infection.
critical_points.zh: 皮膚疾病孩童須監測局部皮膚感染與全身感染。

critical_points.en: Best indicators of burn fluid resuscitation adequacy: HR, urine output, capillary refill, sensorium.
critical_points.zh: 評估燒傷液體復甦是否足夠：心跳、尿量、微血管再充填、意識。

critical_points.en: Burns >10% TBSA in a child require fluid resuscitation.
critical_points.zh: 兒童燒傷 >10% TBSA 需液體復甦。

critical_points.en: Use age-specific charts, not rule of nines, for pediatric burns.
critical_points.zh: 兒童燒傷使用年齡別圖表，不用九分法。

critical_points.en: Lindane shampoo is contraindicated under 2 years (CNS toxicity, seizures).
critical_points.zh: 林丹洗髮精 2 歲以下禁用（中樞神經毒性、癲癇）。

critical_points.en: Scabies = burrows (fine grayish-red lines); impetigo = honey-colored crusts; nits = white sacs stuck to hair shaft.
critical_points.zh: 疥瘡＝隧道（灰紅細線）；膿痂疹＝蜜黃色痂；蝨卵＝黏在髮幹的白色小囊。

critical_points.en: Permethrin goes on all skin surfaces, not just the rash, for 8-14 hours on cool dry skin 30+ minutes after bathing.
critical_points.zh: Permethrin 塗全身皮膚（非僅皮疹）、停留 8–14 小時，須於沐浴 30 分鐘後在涼乾皮膚上使用。

critical_points.en: Treat all household contacts of scabies at the same time.
critical_points.zh: 疥瘡的所有同住接觸者須同時治療。

critical_points.en: Impetigo is contagious for 24 hours after antibiotic start; complete the antibiotic course to prevent glomerulonephritis.
critical_points.zh: 膿痂疹開始抗生素後 24 小時內仍有傳染性；須完成療程以防腎絲球腎炎。

critical_points.en: Topical steroid: thin layer, rubbed in, on affected skin only; apply topical medication within 3 minutes of bath.
critical_points.zh: 外用類固醇：只塗患處、薄層並推開；沐浴後 3 分鐘內塗藥。

critical_points.en: Fire/burn first aid: cool (not cold) water, remove clothing not stuck, cover clean, keep child warm.
critical_points.zh: 燒燙傷急救：涼（非冰）水、移除未黏衣物、乾淨覆蓋、保暖。

mnemonics.en: Eczema triggers to avoid: latex, wool, heat, wet diapers, harsh detergents.
mnemonics.zh: 濕疹誘因：乳膠、羊毛、高溫、濕尿布、刺激性洗劑。

stem.en: The nurse is caring for a child with burns over 15% of the body. Which finding best indicates adequate fluid resuscitation?
stem.zh: 護理師照護燒傷 15% 體表面積的孩童，何項最能顯示液體復甦足夠？

options.en: Decreased edema at the burn site
Capillary refill under 2 seconds with adequate urine output
options.zh: 微血管再充填 <2 秒且尿量足夠

rationale.en: Heart rate, urine output, capillary refill and sensorium are the key parameters.
rationale.zh: 心跳、尿量、微血管再充填與意識狀態為關鍵指標。

stem.en: Which instruction should the nurse give the parent about permethrin for scabies?
stem.zh: 關於疥瘡使用 permethrin，護理師應如何指導家長？

options.en: Apply to all skin on cool dry skin at least 30 minutes after bathing and wash off after 8-14 hours
options.zh: 於沐浴後至少 30 分鐘、涼乾皮膚塗全身，8–14 小時後洗去

rationale.en: Permethrin is applied to all skin surfaces, left 8-14 hours, avoiding the eyes.
rationale.zh: Permethrin 需塗全身皮膚、停留 8–14 小時並避開眼睛。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A prescriber orders lindane shampoo for lice. The nurse questions the order for which child?
stem.zh: 醫師開立林丹洗髮精治療頭蝨，護理師對哪位孩童會提出質疑？

rationale.en: Lindane is contraindicated under 2 years because of absorption, neurotoxicity and seizures.
rationale.zh: 2 歲以下因吸收增加有神經毒性與癲癇風險，禁用林丹。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which statements by a parent about impetigo show correct understanding? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 下列哪些家長對膿痂疹的陳述正確？（多選）

options.en: Lesions often appear around the mouth and nose.
My child can share towels once treatment starts.
options.zh: 開始治療後可共用毛巾。

options.en: Finish all antibiotics even if crusts clear.
options.zh: 即使痂皮消退也要吃完抗生素。

rationale.en: Impetigo is contagious, favors face, is more common in hot humid months, and requires separate linens and full antibiotic course.
rationale.zh: 膿痂疹傳染性高、好發臉部、多見於濕熱季節，需分開使用寢具並完成抗生素療程。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A school nurse inspects a child's scalp. Which finding is a positive head check for lice?
stem.zh: 校護檢查頭皮，何項為頭蝨陽性？

options.en: White flakes that brush off easily
options.zh: 容易拍落的白色片狀物

options.en: White sacs firmly attached to hair shafts at the occiput
options.zh: 枕部髮幹上牢固附著的白色小囊

rationale.en: Nits adhere to the hair shaft near the scalp; flakes are dandruff.
rationale.zh: 蝨卵牢固黏於近頭皮髮幹；片狀物為頭皮屑。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which are pediatric considerations in burn care? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 下列哪些是兒童燒傷照護的考量？（多選）

options.en: Scarring tends to be more severe
Immature immune system raises infection risk
options.zh: 免疫系統未成熟增加感染風險

options.en: Resuscitation is only needed above 25% TBSA
options.zh: 超過 25% TBSA 才需復甦

options.en: Protein and calorie deficiency risk is higher
options.zh: 蛋白質熱量缺乏風險較高

rationale.en: Burns over 10% TBSA need fluids; children have less muscle mass and fat.
rationale.zh: 燒傷超過 10% TBSA 即需液體；兒童肌肉與脂肪較少。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A toddler has atopic dermatitis. Which skin care teaching is correct?
stem.zh: 幼兒有異位性皮膚炎，何項皮膚照護指導正確？

options.zh: 每日兩次長時間熱水浴

options.en: 5-10 minute lukewarm bath then moisturize immediately
options.zh: 5–10 分鐘微溫水浴後立即保濕

rationale.en: Short lukewarm baths followed by immediate moisturizer; avoid irritants.
rationale.zh: 短時間微溫浴後立即保濕；避免刺激物。
